profile.name: Jeevan Reddy Ragula
profile.title: Principal Cloud-Native & AI Security Architect
profile.headline: Principal Cloud-Native & AI Security Architect
profile.description: With 19 years of software engineering experience, I architect cloud-native security and AI security platforms. At Zscaler, my work spans AI Security, Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), and Zscaler Posture Control. I combine hands-on Go engineering with Kubernetes, multi-cloud architecture, distributed data platforms, event-driven systems, and AI-native architectures.

products.title: AI Security / AI Asset Management
products.description: Architecting an AI security and asset-management platform that inventories AI models, agents, MCP servers, workloads and AI identities across cloud and developer ecosystems. The platform brings together model intelligence, provenance and supply-chain risk signals from multiple model providers and registries.
features: AI model, agent, MCP server and workload inventory
Model metadata, provenance and supply-chain risk intelligence
AWS, Azure, GCP, Hugging Face and Ollama sources
Go services, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes and event-driven integrations

products.title: Data Security Posture Management (DSPM)
products.description: Core architect and engineer for cloud-scale DSPM capabilities that discover, classify and monitor sensitive data across cloud storage and databases. Designed distributed scan execution, DLP integration and findings processing for a multi-tenant security platform.
features: DLP findings integration and results processing
Multi-tenant orchestration and scalable scan workflows

products.title: Zscaler Posture Control (ZPC)
products.description: Core engineer and architect on Zscaler Posture Control, spanning multi-cloud inventory, posture management, policy evaluation, infrastructure-as-code security and vulnerability workflows across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes and developer platforms.
features: IaC security integrated into developer workflows

products.title: Enterprise Payment Gateway — GVC / Entain
products.description: Across nine years at IVY Comptech, contributed to a PCI DSS-certified payment gateway and cashier platform used across the GVC / Entain group. The system connected multiple payment providers and methods to a consistent payment experience, supporting deposits and transaction processing for a large online gaming business.
features: Integrated approximately 20 payment methods through REST and SOAP
Payment gateway and cashier workflows for GVC / Entain
Transaction migrations, distributed caching and performance improvements
Security hardening, ELK logging and asynchronous email/SMS alerts

patents.name: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Scanner for Component Security
patents.description: Granted patent for an IaC scanner that parses infrastructure files, evaluates locally executable SQL-based security policies, stores findings and provides remediation guidance before uploading results to a cloud posture platform.

patents.name: Cloud-Based Data Security Posture Management (DSPM)
patents.description: Patent application covering cloud-based DSPM: discovering and classifying data across cloud services and endpoints, monitoring access and usage, evaluating misconfigurations and compliance, and enforcing security policies.

career: Architecting cloud security and AI security platforms including ZPC, DSPM and AI security initiatives. Focus areas include Go microservices, Kubernetes, multi-cloud security, distributed data platforms and AI-native architectures.

Core engineer and technical leader across cloud security products. Resume highlights architecture for IaC and container security, cross-functional engineering, Kafka and CI/CD integrations, threat detection and compliance checks, and scalable infrastructure security.

Architected and built cloud security product capabilities for IaC and container security, with emphasis on scalable, fault-tolerant cloud-native services. (The uploaded resume lists this period within the broader Zscaler role beginning Aug 2021.)

Built a real-time log collection service using AWS S3, Elastic Beanstalk and Kafka with Auto Scaling Groups; integrated Spring Boot services with Prometheus, Grafana and Spring Actuator; enabled FIPS support for FedRAMP High; worked on Cloud Connector configuration and customer health notifications.
IVY Software Development Services Pvt Ltd

Designed and built a PCI DSS-certified payment gateway for GVC using Spring, Apache CXF, Tomcat and Oracle. Integrated around 20 payment methods via REST/SOAP; improved cashier page load to about two seconds; implemented ELK logging, Quick Deposit, large transaction migrations, distributed caching, live chat and asynchronous email/SMS alerts; addressed XSS and CSRF risks.
HP India Software Operations Pvt Ltd

Worked on Serviceguard Manager, a GUI for configuring, monitoring and administering Serviceguard, Serviceguard Extension for RAC, Metrocluster and Continentalclusters. Developed backend and frontend features using Java and JavaScript.

Worked on the Fuel Cell Data Acquisition System for Daimler AG, securely transferring data from data recorders to local file servers and central data management. Developed shell scripts and Java/Struts/DB2 features deployed on WebSphere.
Bachelor of Technology in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University, Hyderabad.
